title: frontmatter-surgery — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins one frontmatter field-patcher case for src/dialect/surgery.ts (main myne repository) — a pure Uint8Array → Uint8Array transform that inserts/replaces/removes one frontmatter field while keeping the rest of the note byte-stable. Eight case_kinds, one per patcher. Each output is a fixed point (idempotent) and the patch is pure. Not a codec and not cryptographic — deterministic cross-client note-mutation behavior. TS-runner category (no Rust generator); the live patchers are asserted by tests/dialect/frontmatterSurgery.test.ts.

expected_output_utf8_hex.description: The exact bytes the patcher MUST produce (hex). A fixed point (idempotent).
